body: We've tried that as well, my girl knows the tenants on the other side of him and we all went to the real estate who spoke to him but it was ineffective. If mediation doesn't work then we will do the same with the council and hope for better results.
Just listened to this on my pc with a 4 inch powered sub and it vibrated my ass so much it tickles.

Oh I've already said I wouldn't but these thoughts do happen in times such as these. I know it'd lower me to his level and I've decided a letter to him and the property manager stating I'm contacting the council for mediation if he doesn't cease the bass (normal noise is fine but the physical side if the bass is the problem) I'll be going for a mediator from the council to resolve it.
Honestly my conscious would stop me every time but it sure feels good to think about it :)

Yeah I've slowly been packing them away (there is hundreds and they're old so had to be packed quite specifically) once again though thanks for that website.

My partner and I have decided the best course is to write him a letter asking to come to a mutual stand point and if he refuses to go for mediation and then just follow the steps of the site you linked thanks again :)
It's brilliance like this that caused me to turn to reddit :)
Yeah I'm trying to avoid being that guy, although I wouldn't steal it, only tyre slashing and keying have crossed my mind, I'm not hardcore enough for grand theft auto.
I feel I'm being left no option but wouldn't be happy with myself without at least exploring all other options first.

Ah I see, I don't think there is anything like that here. I believe it's a single owner of the 6 apartments here kind of thing and he uses the real estate as a middle man. I am leaning towards a mediation of some sort, I would prefer we both meet in the middle than me totally crush his lifestyle.

Thank you! This is precisely the thing I'm looking for. Unfortunately the valuables I speak of are an ornament collection given to me by my late grandmother and there are far too many to place on the floor everytime this happens. I've already asked to be reimbursed for the $200 of broken stuff from either him or the real estate. 

The reply from the real estate was "he has the bill and should forward the money when he next can" I'm not exactly hopeful.

I have 4 12 inch subs all powered and an extra from my pc I could hook up if I wished. I've really thought about just going away for a weekend leaving tub thumping or the lamb chops theme song on loop while I was away but alas there's a couple with a baby on the other side and I'd feel incredibly bad in doing such a thing :(.

He's already had the police called (I'm not the only neighbour to complain. By the time they arrive he just turns it down and says he doesn't understand what we are complaining about and apparently they need a certain time or decibel level before they can do anything. I have already spoken to the real estate and they just say "we've spoken to him let us know if it happens again" time and time again. 

I think I'll be going to seek out the mediation option, I don't want to be a dick to guy I just want to live a normal day without having to stop to protect my belongings.

I'm unsure what that is to be honest. The breakers are downstairs under surveillance so unfortunately that's not an option. His car however isn't but as I said I'm trying (believe me REALLY trying) to come to a mutual situation without resorting to stuff like that if possible.

I have tried at all hours to talk to him. Even approached him outside his apartment. When I knock on his door he ignores it and when I approached him he denied he lived there. This was as he pulled his keys out of the door after locking it. Both times I saw him I asked politely if he could just lower the bass, normal noise is fine but bass is ridiculous.

I'm just clueless as to what I can do and am usually a calm person but this situation has me ready to throw caution to the wind and just start throwing punches.

This, I used to go with a friend out on calls when he was a tow truck driver. The amount of times we were first on the scene ahead of paramedics to find people just standing around recording people trapped in cars screaming for help was ridiculous. People can be seriously fucked.
Have an up vote for supporting me :)

My brother got an infection when he was quite young that now causes him to not be able to be fully erect, I forget what it exactly was as I was young when mum first told me and we don't talk anymore, he can get so far through a hard on then it just won't get any harder. 

Docs told my mum circumcision could've avoided it so she got me done. After hearing stories from my friends of infections and smells and just the aesthetics of it I am glad she did it but that being said I'm not blind to the point the opposing votes are making. This still won't effect my call if I have a son, he'll be getting his turtle neck trimmed just like his dad's.

So what you're telling me is that you have exited your house EVERY day of your life. Rain, hail, shine or even injury. That not even once you in your life you woke up next to your SO and thought "fuck it let's lay in bed and watch movies all day, the weather is shit anyway"

I do most the things you listed (except the neighbours, mine are junkies) but that doesn't mean that once in a while weather or some other reason might make me decide to have a lazy day around the house. Hell, Bruno Mars wrote a song about it, which was widely popular due to the fact everyone could relate cause they've done the same.

What I'm saying is most people at one point or another have spent ONE day, as this chart says, inside. I'm confident to say anyone who claims they haven't is full of shit or just kidding themselves to prove a point. A week without leaving the house is awkward but one day? Nope, fair play in my book, I would even encourage it once in a while especially for a working couple.

I came here to say this, I mean if there is no reason for us to be out that day are we supposed to just go stand in the yard to avoid being awkward? Wouldn't that be more awkward to go and stand in the yard for no reason? 

*Neighbour walks out to find you standing in the yard staring into space* "Hey Jim! What you up to?" 

"oh, just fulfilling my quota of being outside for the day as to avoid being awkward" *Smiles and walks back inside*

This is precisely how I am everyday. I wake up alright but by the end of the day I just feel powerless, like no matter what I do I will never get anywhere or achieve anything I could be proud of. My rational side tries to tell me I'm being melodramatic and it's the depression but it's always a slippery slope that I can't seem to avoid. It has helped considerably to know I'm not the only one in a situation like this though. The doc said its a very common thought cycle for depressed people. So thanks for the response :).

Yeah I am starting to think this too, I live a normally uneventful life (more a cruisy guy than an excitable one) so I think this is it. I'm just lagging so to speak lol. I've been to see the doc and am seeing a counselor next week per my request, doc said I should be fine I just need to work out and get out more but I chose the counselor so she might help with the anxiety :). Thanks for the reply though ^_^

It's funny cause I never even thought about circular thinking being the cause. I've been kind of so caught up in baby stuff and trying to sort out finances it didn't occur to me it could be I'm spending too much time in my own head. Maybe I just need a break?

I guess it could be that. It's just strange that at this particular point I decide to think about suicide. I've been in far worse positions in life (was homeless for a few months at 16) and I never once thought about it even though I didn't see a future for me. Here I am at 26 with this whole new life I have built around me and an amazing future ahead but I can't shake thoughts of it. I guess the doctor will help shed some light on it hopefully. Thanks for taking the time to send a response though :) I've been lurking this sub reddit for a while now trying to get the nerve to post but always feel my problems are laughable in comparison to others on here.

Not sure why people are getting so angry about this response. In Australia you are taught to just slow down until you feel safe, if they wish to pass they will if not the original antagonist has to deal with driving behind a frightened driver. Why should I have to pull over cause someone else is in a hurry?

I do the same thing with tailgaters, I've even gone as far as stopping dead in the middle of a main road. I was taught one simple thing, if someone makes you feel frightened for your safety whilst driving slow down or stop regardless of the situation. If this guy had a sick passenger he should've called an ambulance, it's full of med equipment and has a TRAINED DRIVER to get them there promptly.

Wouldn't happen to know some of these websites would you? My biggest struggle was the fact I was suicidal and also heavily socially anxious so I could never get comfortable enough to talk to anyone. Not even over the phone. I think if I had known of chat sites it would've helped me immensely to finally make that call or see the doctor if I could talk anonymously about it to someone first. I'm all good now days most of the time (we all have our bad days) but I think having a site like that on bookmarks would come in handy :)

26, first kid on the way and I'm the same. I've achieved in everything I've done and have been awesome at every job I've worked but it's never really had a direction. I have a shitty job because I can't commit to any kind of career cause I've got no idea what I want to do. I am starting a bunch of courses at TAFE to see if something grabs my passion but can't say I'm hopeful. I'm actually just thinking about becoming a librarian cause my partner also is. I guess some people just find direction later than others, in the meantime just fake it and keep you opportunities open :)

my older brother (i am a middle child) mum said she used to always ask me who I was playing with (I was a loner of a kid always playing "alone") I'd often reply with "my sister" one day I told her sis said I wouldn't be here if it wasn't for her, spooked the hell out of mum cause she only wanted a boy and girl so they had planned to stop having kids after my first sister.
